title: The Minimum Wage as an Anchor: Effects on Determinations of Fairness by Humans and AI

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting human subjects and an AI language model (GPT-3) with different numerical minimum wage values (anchors) to measure shifts in their determination of what constitutes a fair wage.
Counterfactual pronoun substitution in prompts (changing the pronoun 'they' to 'he' or 'she') to observe changes in the AI model's numerical fair wage predictions.
Counterfactual name substitution in prompts using race-stereotypical names (e.g., DeShawn, Shanice) to observe differences in the AI model's fair wage predictions.
